tldr: 台股在台積電法說會前開低重挫，全球晶片與記憶體賣壓拖累大盤盤中一度跌逾600點，亞股同步走弱。
台灣13家上市金控上半年大賺4,408.7億元、年增逾一倍創同期新高，富邦金以純益973億元奪獲利王。
美國6月通膨降溫優於預期，CPI年增3.5%、PPI意外下滑0.3%，但新任聯準會主席華許態度謹慎、未釋出明確降息訊號。
主管機關收緊利變型保單銷售、推進虛擬資產專法，金管會上半年裁罰逼近1億元、銀行業首當其衝。
美伊衝突與海上封鎖升溫，使油價與地緣風險續居焦點，但科技巨頭勁揚仍推升華爾街再創新高。

items.title_zh: 台積電法說前台股重挫 晶片、記憶體回檔
items.title_en: Taiex slumps ahead of TSMC earnings as chip and memory names correct
items.summary_zh: 台股週四開低走弱，早盤一度下跌近480點、跌幅擴大至逾600點並回測5日線。賣壓出現在台積電第二季法說會登場前數小時，主因半導體權值股獲利了結，加上前波急漲的記憶體概念股拉回修正。外資已連續第9個交易日站在賣方。此波下殺與亞洲科技股同步走弱相呼應，市場對AI與晶片估值偏高的疑慮升溫，即便大盤前一日才靠近900點的漲幅重返45,000點之上，投資人仍轉趨保守觀望，靜待台積電法說釋出的營運展望與資本支出指引再定方向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index opened sharply lower on Thursday, falling nearly 480 points early and extending losses to more than 600 points as it retested its five-day moving average. The pullback came hours before TSMC's closely watched second-quarter earnings call and was driven by profit-taking in semiconductor heavyweights and a correction in memory-related shares, which had staged a sharp rally in prior sessions. Foreign investors stayed net sellers for a ninth straight day. The selloff mirrored weakness across Asian tech names as caution over stretched AI and chip valuations spread, leaving traders wary despite the market having reclaimed the 45,000 level a day earlier on a near-900-point surge.

items.title_zh: 台積電法說登場在即 美銀、小摩上調目標價至3,100元
items.title_en: BofA and JPMorgan lift TSMC target to NT$3,100 before Q2 call
items.summary_zh: 台積電16日召開第二季法說會，美銀與摩根大通證券在最新前瞻報告中同步維持「買進」評等，並將目標價調升至3,100元，並列外資圈第八高。美銀以「美銀三問」聚焦台積電未來營運，小摩則點出「ADR避險神操作」策略可望增添報酬。法說前偏多的報告，反映法人對台積電受惠AI加速器帶動先進製程需求仍具信心，即便整體晶片族群正進行修正。市場關注本次法說對資本支出、毛利率走勢與海外廠進度的說明，這些變數都可能重新定調權值股與大盤後續氣氛，成為短線多空攻防關鍵。
items.summary_en: Ahead of TSMC's second-quarter earnings conference on July 16, Bank of America and J.P. Morgan Securities both reiterated "buy" ratings and raised their target prices to NT$3,100, the eighth-highest among foreign brokerages. BofA framed the report around three key questions on TSMC's future operations, while J.P. Morgan highlighted an "ADR hedging" strategy it argued could enhance returns. The bullish pre-earnings notes reflect continued confidence in TSMC's advanced-process demand from AI accelerators, even as the broader chip sector corrects. Investors are watching for updates on capital spending, gross-margin trajectory and overseas fab progress, all of which could reset sentiment for the heavyweight and the wider Taiwan market.

items.title_zh: 股市震盪散戶頻翻車 今年違約交割累計達20件
items.title_en: Default fiascos widen as retail traders get burned, cases hit 20 this year
items.summary_zh: 台股近期走勢劇烈，再度引爆散戶違約「翻車」。證交所與櫃買中心同步公告，被動元件大廠禾伸堂與銅箔基板廠台燿分別遭券商申報違約交割，其中禾伸堂單日更遭多達10家券商通報。統計今年以來上市櫃違約交割災情已累計達20件，凸顯前波飆漲的被動元件與AI相關個股急拉急殺，讓使用融資槓桿的散戶部位承受劇烈壓力。主管機關與交易所持續密切關注此趨勢，提醒投資人熱門族群投機氣氛過熱時，價格反轉往往帶來違約風險，操作應留意資金控管與停損紀律，避免追高殺低造成無法交割的窘境。
items.summary_en: Volatile Taiwan trading has triggered another wave of settlement defaults among retail investors. The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the Taipei Exchange jointly announced that passive-component maker Yageo peer Holy Stone (禾伸堂) and copper-clad-laminate firm Elite Material peer Thinflex (台燿) were each reported by brokers for settlement defaults, with Holy Stone flagged by as many as ten brokerages in a single day. Cumulative listed and OTC default cases have now reached 20 so far this year, underscoring how sharp swings in high-flying components and AI-related names have left leveraged retail traders exposed. Regulators and exchanges continue to monitor the trend as speculative froth in hot sectors periodically unwinds.

items.title_zh: 聯電出關飆漲停 創新板誕生第二檔千金股
items.title_en: UMC leaps by daily limit on disciplinary exit as innovation board mints second NT$1,000 stock
items.summary_zh: 聯電取消處置交易、正式「出關」首日股價飆上漲停，成為晶圓代工與中小型股焦點。另一方面，台灣創新板誕生第二家千金股，沛爾生醫股價攻上漲停1,025元，市值達672億元創歷史新高，當日外資買超280張、金額2.85億元，創近一年新高。在權值晶片股回檔之際，這兩檔標的的強勢表現，凸顯台股資金持續輪動、投機氣氛不減，游資從晶圓代工題材到高價生技新股輪流追逐。市場提醒，個股短線急漲後波動加大，投資人宜留意基本面與籌碼面變化，避免在高檔追價後承受回檔風險，操作上仍須回歸公司營運展望評估。
items.summary_en: United Microelectronics (UMC) surged by its daily limit as it exited the exchange's disciplinary-trading restriction, drawing heavy attention among small-cap and foundry names. Separately, Taiwan's Innovation Board produced its second "thousand-dollar" stock as Peror Bio (沛爾生醫) hit its daily limit at NT$1,025, lifting its market value to a record NT$67.2 billion; foreign investors net bought 280 lots worth NT$285 million, the highest in nearly a year. The moves highlight rotating speculative appetite in Taiwan even as large-cap chip names correct, with liquidity chasing catalysts from foundry newsflow to high-priced biotech listings on the growth-focused board.

items.title_zh: 英特爾傳大砍台積電2奈米訂單 業界解讀先進製程良率躍進
items.title_en: Intel reportedly slashes TSMC 2nm orders as its own yields improve
items.summary_zh: 外電引述供應鏈消息指出，英特爾下一代「Nova Lake-S」處理器生產策略大轉向，從原訂約六至七成委由台積電2奈米代工，改為多數由自家生產，外包比重降至20%以下，等於大砍台積電逾六成訂單量。業界解讀，此舉反映英特爾自家先進製程良率明顯躍進，才有信心把產能拉回內部。若消息屬實，恐對台積電先進製程接單動能的市場預期造成影響，不過台積電受惠AI帶動的廣大客戶基礎，產能仍供不應求。這則報導為近期一片看好先進節點需求的氛圍增添變數，也提醒投資人留意大客戶自製策略調整對代工版圖的牽動。
items.summary_en: Supply-chain sources cited by foreign media say Intel is sharply reversing course on its next-generation "Nova Lake-S" processors, shifting from an originally planned 60–70% outsourced to TSMC's 2nm process to keeping most production in-house, cutting external outsourcing to below 20%. That would slash TSMC's order volume for the chip by more than 60%. Industry watchers read the move as a sign that Intel's advanced-process yields have leapt forward, giving it confidence to reclaim in-house manufacturing. If confirmed, the shift could dent expectations for TSMC's leading-edge order book, though TSMC's broad AI-driven customer base leaves it heavily booked. The report adds a note of caution amid an otherwise buoyant advanced-node demand narrative.

items.title_zh: 艾司摩爾三度上修展望、將大擴產 家登、帆宣、翔名受惠
items.title_en: ASML lifts 2026 outlook a third time, plans major capacity expansion
items.summary_zh: 微影設備龍頭艾司摩爾（ASML）15日三度上修2026年營運展望，並釋出明、後年兩大產品線將擴產約三成的訊息，記憶體設備需求為主要推力，全年財測上修約16%。法人看好台系供應鏈家登、帆宣、翔名等，可望受惠於優於預期的接單動能與多年期擴產計畫。此次上修進一步強化市場觀點：AI帶動先進邏輯與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求，正推升晶圓製造設備支出遠超先前估計，也支撐半導體設備循環延續至2028年。對台廠而言，設備龍頭擴產有助零組件與工程服務接單能見度，成為AI供應鏈中相對明確的受惠環節，後續仍須觀察終端擴產節奏。
items.summary_en: Lithography leader ASML on July 15 raised its 2026 operating outlook for the third time and signalled it would expand two key product lines by around 30% over the next two years, with memory-equipment demand cited as the main driver; it lifted its full-year forecast by roughly 16%. Analysts expect Taiwanese supply-chain names such as Gudeng Precision, Marketech (帆宣) and Scientech (翔名) to benefit from the better-than-expected order momentum and multi-year expansion plans. The upgrade reinforces the view that AI-fuelled demand for advanced logic and high-bandwidth memory is pushing wafer-fab equipment spending well beyond earlier estimates, supporting the broader semiconductor-equipment cycle into 2028.

items.title_zh: AI需求爆發、中東衝突推升成本 台塑兩大電子化學品喊漲
items.title_en: AI-driven demand and Middle East conflict push Formosa Plastics to rare electronic-chemical price hikes
items.summary_zh: AI推升台積電先進製程接單強勁，帶動電子級化學品需求爆發，加上中東衝突導致化工原料大漲，台塑反映市況與成本，旗下電子級氫氟酸（HF）與電子級異丙醇（IPA）兩大電子級化學品報價罕見「雙漲」。電子級化學品是半導體清洗、蝕刻的關鍵耗材，報價走揚同時反映下游晶圓廠稼動強勁與上游原料成本上升。此次調漲凸顯AI資本支出循環正從晶片端外溢至materials材料供應鏈，讓具備先進製程曝險的特用化學品供應商受惠。對台塑而言，高值化電子材料放量有助產品組合優化，市場後續將觀察漲價幅度能否延續，以及中東地緣情勢對原料成本的後續影響。
items.summary_en: Surging AI-related orders at TSMC's advanced nodes are fuelling booming demand for electronic-grade chemicals, while the Middle East conflict has driven up chemical feedstock costs. In response, Formosa Plastics is raising prices on two major electronic-grade products—electronic-grade hydrofluoric acid (HF) and isopropyl alcohol (IPA)—a rare simultaneous "double increase" reflecting both tight market conditions and cost pressure. Electronic-grade chemicals are critical consumables in semiconductor cleaning and etching, so firmer pricing signals both robust downstream fab utilisation and rising input costs. The move underscores how the AI capex cycle is rippling beyond chipmakers into the materials supply chain, benefiting specialty-chemical suppliers with exposure to advanced-process fabs.

items.title_zh: 輝達深化豐田合作 推動實體AI落實至智慧城市和工廠
items.title_en: Nvidia deepens Toyota tie-up to bring physical AI to smart cities and factories
items.summary_zh: 輝達（Nvidia）擴大與豐田的合作，推動「實體AI」（physical AI）落實到智慧城市與製造工廠等真實場域。雙方合作聚焦將先進AI運算與機器人能力導入工業與城市環境，讓生成式與實體AI從資料中心走向工廠、移動載具與基礎建設。此合作呼應產業趨勢——領先的AI晶片平台與大型製造商攜手，加速自動化、自駕系統與數位孿生（digital twin）落地。對台灣硬體供應鏈而言，輝達與豐田加深合作，有助強化AI運算模組、機器人零組件與邊緣裝置的需求能見度，也把AI投資題材從雲端基礎建設延伸到實體世界的工業應用，為相關台廠帶來中長期想像空間，惟實際放量節奏仍待觀察。
items.summary_en: Nvidia is expanding its collaboration with Toyota to push "physical AI" into real-world applications spanning smart cities and manufacturing plants. The partnership aims to embed advanced AI computing and robotics capabilities into industrial and urban settings, moving generative and physical AI beyond data centres and into factories, mobility and infrastructure. The tie-up reflects a broader industry trend of pairing leading AI-chip platforms with large manufacturers to accelerate automation, autonomous systems and digital-twin deployments. For Taiwan's hardware supply chain, deeper Nvidia–Toyota cooperation reinforces demand visibility for AI computing modules, robotics components and edge devices, extending the AI investment theme from cloud infrastructure into physical-world industrial applications.

items.title_zh: SEMI：全球半導體設備市場連五增 2028年估達2,295億美元新高
items.title_en: Global chip-equipment sales set to grow for a fifth year, hitting record by 2028
items.summary_zh: 國際半導體產業協會（SEMI）指出，2026年全球半導體製造設備銷售額預估達1,659億美元，較2025年成長23.2%，創歷史新高。在AI需求持續驅動下，SEMI預期全球半導體製造投資動能可延續至2028年，屆時設備銷售可望攀升至2,295億美元，將是連續第五年成長。此樂觀預測與ASML等設備商近期偏多訊號一致，顯示支撐先進邏輯與記憶體晶圓廠擴產的資本支出循環具持續性。對台灣設備與零組件供應商而言，多年期成長展望有助鞏固AI帶動半導體建置潮下的接單能見度，惟仍須留意終端需求與擴產節奏變化，避免市場對設備循環過度樂觀而忽略調整風險。
items.summary_en: Industry body SEMI said global semiconductor manufacturing equipment sales are forecast to reach US$165.9 billion in 2026, up 23.2% from 2025 and a record high. Driven by sustained AI demand, SEMI expects worldwide semiconductor manufacturing investment momentum to continue through 2028, when equipment sales could climb to US$229.5 billion—a fifth consecutive year of growth. The upbeat forecast aligns with recent bullish signals from equipment makers such as ASML and points to a durable capex cycle underpinning fab expansion for advanced logic and memory. For Taiwan's equipment and components suppliers, the multi-year growth outlook supports order visibility across the AI-driven semiconductor build-out.

items.title_zh: 13金控上半年大賺4,408億創同期新高 富邦金奪獲利王
items.title_en: Taiwan's 13 financial holdings post record H1 profit of NT$440.9 billion; Fubon crowned king
items.summary_zh: 國內13家上市金控上半年獲利成績單全數揭曉，6月單月稅後純益合計734.9億元；累計上半年金控業大賺4,408.7億元，刷新歷史同期新高，年增率達101%，續寫三位數成長。富邦金以純益973億元、EPS 6.67元奪下獲利王，居同業之冠。亮眼成績主要受惠台股強勢帶動投資與保險收益、銀行手續費收入穩健，以及資本市場活絡。此創高獲利凸顯金控業對多頭市場的獲利槓桿，但也引發市場對下半年市況若回歸常態、獲利動能能否延續的討論。整體而言，金控上半年在資本市場助攻下繳出強勁表現，惟後續須觀察投資收益波動與利差變化對獲利結構的影響。
items.summary_en: All 13 of Taiwan's listed financial holding companies have reported first-half results, with combined June net profit of NT$73.49 billion. Cumulative first-half after-tax net profit reached NT$440.87 billion, a record for the period and up 101% year-on-year—continuing a triple-digit growth streak. Fubon Financial took the earnings crown with net profit of NT$97.3 billion and EPS of NT$6.67, the highest among peers. The bumper results were underpinned by strong equity markets boosting investment and insurance income, robust banking fee income and buoyant capital-market activity. The record haul highlights the sector's earnings leverage to buoyant markets, though it also raises questions about sustainability if market conditions normalise in the second half.

items.title_zh: 金管會上半年裁罰近億元 銀行業連吞三張大單
items.title_en: FSC's first-half fines near NT$100 million as banks take three big hits
items.summary_zh: 受銀行業第2季連吞三張「大罰單」影響，2026年上半年金融三業與上市櫃公司裁罰額攀升至9,787萬元；光第2季單季就達7,549萬元，是首季的3.4倍，其中銀行業就包辦逾七成，呈現「小案少、大案加重」的態勢。此模式顯示主管機關將裁罰火力集中在重大合規缺失，而非例行性違規。裁罰金額走高凸顯監理對銀行業的檢查趨嚴，也對金融機構形成警示，提醒業者在監理力道加強之際，須強化內部控制與法遵架構，落實風險控管。對財富管理與跨境業務比重高的銀行而言，法遵成本與監理風險上升，將是後續營運須持續關注的重點課題。
items.summary_en: Financial Supervisory Commission penalties on the three financial sectors and listed companies climbed to NT$97.87 million in the first half of 2026, driven by banks absorbing three "big" fines in the second quarter. Second-quarter penalties alone reached NT$75.49 million—3.4 times the first quarter's total—with banks accounting for more than 70% of the amount. The pattern shows "fewer small cases but heavier large ones," signalling that regulators are concentrating enforcement on major compliance failures rather than routine infractions. The elevated penalties underscore tightening supervisory scrutiny of the banking sector and serve as a warning to financial institutions to reinforce internal controls and compliance frameworks amid stepped-up regulatory oversight.

items.title_zh: 五大行6月刷卡創歷史新高 玉山銀首登頂奪刷卡王
items.title_en: Five major banks' June card spending hits record NT$608.8 billion; E.Sun tops the table
items.summary_zh: 稅款遞延入帳挹注下，五大行6月合計刷卡金額達6,088億元、創歷史新高，其中玉山銀首度登頂奪下「刷卡王」寶座。五大行刷卡量年增顯著，反映消費動能穩健、大額稅款與日常支付移轉至信用卡，以及發卡行間積極的回饋競爭。此創高表現凸顯消費支付量與手續費收入仍是消金業務亮點，各行透過現金回饋與生活場景綁定爭取高消費族群。玉山銀首度登頂，也顯示台灣信用卡與支付市場競爭日趨激烈。對銀行而言，刷卡量走高有助手續費收入成長，但回饋競賽亦墊高成本，後續須觀察在爭取市占與維持獲利間如何取得平衡，並留意消費動能能否延續支撐卡量表現。
items.summary_en: Aided by deferred tax-payment postings, Taiwan's five major banks recorded a record NT$608.8 billion in credit-card spending in June, with E.Sun Bank claiming the top spot as card-spending champion for the first time. Card-spending volumes across the five banks jumped sharply year-on-year, reflecting resilient consumption, the migration of large tax and everyday payments onto cards, and aggressive rewards competition among issuers. The record showing highlights how consumer-payment volumes and interchange-linked fee income remain a bright spot for retail banking, even as institutions vie for higher-spending cardholders through cashback and lifestyle-linked promotions. E.Sun's debut at the top signals intensifying competition in Taiwan's cards and payments market.

items.title_zh: 七壽險新契約保費上半年年增61% 投資型保單熱銷
items.title_en: Seven life insurers' new-policy premiums surge 61% in H1 on investment-linked demand
items.summary_zh: 受惠台股上半年持續走強，帶動投資型保單熱銷，加上分紅保單需求延續，七大壽險新契約保費收入（FYP）持續成長。七大壽險6月合計新契約保費收入達1,120.5億元，年成長71%；累計上半年FYP年增61%、衝上5,518億元。此波成長凸顯多頭市場正引導家庭資金流向投資型與分紅保單，重塑壽險業商品組合與通路重心。對財富管理通路而言，此趨勢顯示市場連結型保險方案需求強勁，但也凸顯在客戶追逐報酬之際，商品適合度（KYC/KYP）把關的重要性。後續須觀察市場若轉弱，投資型保單買氣是否隨之降溫，以及利率與資本市場波動對壽險新契約結構的影響。
items.summary_en: Buoyed by a persistently strong Taiwan equity market, the seven largest life insurers saw booming sales of investment-linked policies, while sustained demand for participating (dividend) policies added further momentum. Combined June first-year premium (FYP) income for the seven insurers reached NT$112.05 billion, up 71% year-on-year, while cumulative first-half FYP climbed 61% to NT$551.8 billion. The surge underscores how buoyant markets are steering household savings toward investment-linked and dividend products, reshaping insurers' product mix and distribution priorities. For wealth-management channels, the trend highlights strong appetite for market-linked insurance solutions, though it also raises the importance of suitability checks as customers chase returns in a rallying market.

items.title_zh: 利變保單不能當定存賣 金管會祭出三道防線
items.title_en: Interest-sensitive policies 'not to be sold as time deposits'—FSC erects three defence lines
items.summary_zh: 金管會出手防止利率變動型（利變型）保單被當成銀行定存替代品不當銷售，修正人身保險業辦理利變型保險商品業務應注意事項，強化銷售行為把關。收緊後的規範建立「三道防線」，確保此類保單以其保障與長期特性行銷，而非被定位為短期儲蓄工具。此舉針對長期存在的不當銷售風險——客戶在未充分了解解約成本、流動性限制與非保證項目下，將利變保單視為高利定存。對財富管理與銀行保險（bancassurance）通路而言，新規強化了商品適合度紀律與更清楚的資訊揭露，尤其在保單需求強勁之際更顯重要。後續業者須落實銷售話術控管與KYC/KYP流程，避免衍生客訴與監理裁罰風險，維護消費者權益。
items.summary_en: The FSC has moved to prevent interest-sensitive (interest-variable) insurance policies from being mis-sold as substitutes for bank time deposits, revising rules governing life insurers' handling of interest-variable insurance products to strengthen sales-practice safeguards. The tightened requirements set up "three lines of defence" to ensure such policies are marketed on their protection and long-term features rather than positioned as short-term savings vehicles. The move targets a recurring mis-selling risk in which customers treat interest-sensitive products as high-yield deposits without fully understanding surrender costs, liquidity constraints and non-guaranteed elements. For wealth managers and bancassurance channels, the rules reinforce suitability discipline and clearer disclosure in an environment of strong policy demand.

items.title_zh: 中信銀亞灣旗艦分行開幕 開創私銀、家辦新格局
items.title_en: CTBC Bank opens flagship Kaohsiung Asia-Bay branch, pioneering private-bank and family-office model
items.summary_zh: 中信銀行於高雄亞洲新灣區舉行全新旗艦型「亞灣分行」開幕，為全台第159家分行，也是最頂級分行之一，占地近500坪、位於高樓層並採預約制。此分行呼應金管會「留財引資」政策，並支持在高雄打造亞洲資產管理中心的目標。分行融合在地設計元素與高資產客戶服務理念，定位為引領私人銀行與家族辦公室（family office）業務，中信銀強調其高資產客群市占居冠。此開幕反映台灣銀行業競相透過旗艦型、體驗導向的財富管理據點，爭取富裕與超高淨值客戶。在亞灣區資產管理專區政策帶動下，各行私銀與家辦布局加速，後續競爭焦點將落在客製化傳承與跨境資產配置服務能量。
items.summary_en: CTBC Bank held the opening of its new flagship "Asia Bay" branch in Kaohsiung's Asia New Bay Area, its 159th branch nationwide and one of its most premium, spanning nearly 500 ping across a high floor on an appointment-only basis. The branch responds to the FSC's "retain wealth, attract capital" policy and supports the goal of establishing an Asian asset-management centre in Kaohsiung. Blending local design elements with a high-net-worth service concept, the branch is positioned to lead in private banking and family-office services, where CTBC says it ranks first in high-asset-client market share. The launch reflects intensifying competition among Taiwanese banks to capture affluent and ultra-high-net-worth clients through flagship, experience-led wealth centres.

items.title_zh: 舊制勞工也能自提6%到退休金專戶領「分紅」 17日上路
items.title_en: Pure old-system workers gain option to voluntarily contribute 6% to pension accounts
items.summary_zh: 勞動部修正發布勞工退休金條例施行細則，新增「勞退純舊制勞工自願提繳及提前結存退休金」方案，7月17日正式上路。對於在勞退新制施行前就已在職、且選擇繼續適用勞基法舊制的「純舊制」勞工來說，過去被排除在個人專戶制度之外，如今可自願提繳最高6%薪資，並分享退休金基金的投資收益（分紅）。此修正為長期不在新制退休金體系內的族群增添退休規劃彈性，提供具租稅優惠、由專業管理的儲蓄管道，擴大退休所得累積的選項。對財富管理與退休規劃實務而言，此新增自提機制可納入客戶整體退休金流試算，協助評估自提6%的節稅與複利效果，強化長期資產配置建議。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Labor has amended the enforcement rules of the Labor Pension Act to add a scheme allowing "pure old-system" workers—those already employed before the act took effect and who chose to remain under the old Labor Standards Act framework—to make voluntary contributions and early lump-sum deposits into a pension account, taking effect July 17. Previously excluded from the individual-account system, these workers can now voluntarily contribute up to 6% of wages and share in investment returns ("dividends") on the pension fund. The change adds flexibility to retirement planning for a group long outside the new pension regime, giving them a tax-advantaged, professionally managed savings channel and broadening options for retirement-income accumulation.

items.title_zh: 虛擬資產專法三讀 勤業眾信籲企業從三大方向布局
items.title_en: Virtual-asset act clears final reading; Deloitte urges firms to prepare on three fronts
items.summary_zh: 台灣虛擬資產專法（VASP專法）三讀通過，虛擬資產服務正式邁入法制化監管時代。勤業眾信呼籲企業從三大策略方向布局，以因應全新的法遵環境，涵蓋治理、風險管理，以及合規服務能量的建置。此立法為虛擬資產服務提供者（VASP）建立更明確的發照、保管與消費者保護要求，使產業從以自律為主的環境邁向受監理的架構。對涉足加密資產、穩定幣與代幣化服務的企業而言，專法重塑了法遵義務、稅務與申報考量，以及競爭版圖，因此在正式施行前及早做好監理整備至關重要。企業宜盤點現行業務模式與法規落差，評估發照、洗錢防制與稅務申報影響，及早調整合規架構以掌握市場先機。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's virtual-asset special law (VASP act) has passed its third reading, ushering in a formal regulatory era for digital-asset services. Deloitte Taiwan (勤業眾信) is urging enterprises to position themselves along three strategic directions to adapt to the new compliance landscape, spanning governance, risk management and the build-out of compliant service offerings. The legislation establishes clearer licensing, custody and consumer-protection requirements for virtual-asset service providers, moving the sector from a largely self-regulated environment into a supervised framework. For companies engaging with crypto assets, stablecoins and tokenised services, the act reshapes compliance obligations, tax and reporting considerations, and the competitive landscape, making early preparation on regulatory readiness essential ahead of implementation.

items.title_zh: VASP攜銀行攻企業穩定幣結算 解決跨境收付痛點
items.title_en: VASPs partner with banks to launch corporate stablecoin settlement
items.summary_zh: 搶攻台灣進出口商機，兩大虛擬資產服務商（VASP）攜手銀行業，搶進「企業穩定幣結算服務」市場，瞄準貿易企業剛需，解決其跨境收付款耗時且耗成本的痛點。隨著台灣進入虛擬資產專法時代，此合作希望為進出口商提供以穩定幣結算跨境交易、更快更省成本的替代方案。此服務反映受監理的數位資產基礎設施，開始與主流企業財務與貿易金融交會，在匯率劇烈波動與全球供應鏈重組下，為進出口業者帶來效率提升。此舉象徵非典型跨境金流在合規架構下，正加速導入台灣產業生態。對銀行而言，結合VASP發展企業穩定幣結算，可望開拓新型態手續費收入來源，惟仍須符合洗錢防制與外匯相關法規要求。
items.summary_en: Two major virtual-asset service providers (VASPs) have teamed up with banks to enter the "corporate stablecoin settlement" market, targeting the real needs of trading enterprises by tackling the pain points of slow, costly cross-border collections and payments. As Taiwan enters the era of its virtual-asset special law, the tie-up aims to give import-export firms a faster, cheaper alternative for settling cross-border transactions using stablecoins. The service reflects how regulated digital-asset infrastructure is beginning to intersect with mainstream corporate treasury and trade finance, offering exporters and importers efficiency gains amid volatile exchange rates and reconfigured global supply chains. The move signals a shift of non-traditional cross-border payment flows into Taiwan's industrial ecosystem under a compliant framework.

items.title_zh: 電子業、貿易商 穩定幣服務二大客群
items.title_en: Electronics makers and traders emerge as two key customer groups for stablecoin services
items.summary_zh: 隨著虛擬資產專法時代來臨，非典型的跨境金流服務正在台灣產業鏈激起漣漪。上市櫃公司與中小企業在面對全球供應鏈重組、國際匯率劇烈波動的挑戰下，對合規、高效的穩定幣收付展現出超乎預期的剛性需求，特別是電子業。電子業與貿易商成為兩大主要客群，反映其跨境金流曝險高、對結算速度與成本高度敏感。此趨勢顯示受監理的穩定幣基礎設施，可望重塑與貿易相關的企業財務操作，讓出口導向的台灣企業在合規架構下，取得管理匯率風險、簡化國際收付的新工具。對主管機關與業者而言，如何在效率與洗錢防制、稅務申報之間取得平衡，將是穩定幣結算服務能否健康發展的關鍵。
items.summary_en: With the arrival of Taiwan's virtual-asset special law era, non-traditional cross-border payment services are rippling through the country's industrial chains. Listed companies and small-and-medium enterprises facing global supply-chain restructuring and sharp exchange-rate volatility are showing stronger-than-expected, rigid demand for compliant, efficient stablecoin collections and payments—particularly in the electronics sector. Electronics manufacturers and trading firms have emerged as the two main customer groups, reflecting their high exposure to cross-border flows and sensitivity to settlement speed and cost. The trend illustrates how regulated stablecoin infrastructure could reshape trade-related treasury operations, giving export-oriented Taiwanese firms new tools to manage currency risk and streamline international collections and disbursements under a supervised framework.

items.title_zh: 政院拍板青安3.0 設四大緊箍咒 利息補貼退場溯及既往
items.title_en: Cabinet to approve 'Youth Housing 3.0' with four new curbs; subsidy taper is retroactive
items.summary_zh: 行政院院會拍板「青安3.0」方案，新制自8月1日上路，實施至2029年7月31日、為期三年。新制新增四大「緊箍咒」：年齡限制、房屋總價上限、排富機制，以及「3+3」利息補貼退場機制，前三年後利息補貼將逐步退場。值得注意的是，利息補貼減碼溯及既往，適用於既有貸款戶。此次改版旨在讓補助更精準鎖定真正首購的年輕族群，並抑制方案的財政成本與助長房市投機的可能，是台灣重要住宅支持政策的一次重大調整。對財富管理與房貸客群而言，補貼退場與排富、房價上限將影響購屋族的資金規劃，銀行房貸業務量與利差結構亦可能隨政策調整而變動，後續須觀察對房市買氣的實際衝擊。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Executive Yuan is set to approve the "Youth Housing 3.0" (青安3.0) scheme, with the new rules taking effect August 1 and running for three years to July 31, 2029. The revised programme adds four "tightening" mechanisms: an age limit, a house-price cap, a means-testing (wealth-exclusion) provision, and a "3+3" interest-subsidy taper under which interest support phases out after the first three years. Notably, the reduced interest subsidy applies retroactively to existing borrowers. The overhaul aims to better target assistance at genuine first-home young buyers and rein in the programme's fiscal cost and potential to fuel property speculation, marking a significant recalibration of one of Taiwan's flagship housing-support policies.

items.title_zh: 軍公教調薪方案出爐 明年加薪4% 專業、主管加給調增2千元
items.title_en: Civil servants and military to get 4% pay rise next year; supervisory allowances jump
items.summary_zh: 政府拍板軍公教調薪方案，7月起專業加給與主管加給調增2千元，並訂明年加薪4%。其中專業加給增幅估計顯著攀升，部分職級約達20%，牽動約160億元經費。此次調整反映政府在生活成本上升之際，力求維持公部門待遇競爭力並支撐家庭購買力。作為近年較大規模的公部門調薪，此措施具財政意涵，也可能影響整體薪資設定預期、民間部門薪資參考基準，以及未來一年的內需消費。對總體經濟而言，公部門調薪有助支撐內需與消費信心，但同時墊高政府經常性支出，後續財政負擔與對民間加薪的外溢效果，值得持續觀察，並留意其對通膨與消費結構的影響。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's government has finalised a pay-adjustment plan for military personnel, civil servants and public-school teachers, raising professional and supervisory allowances by NT$2,000 from July and setting a 4% salary increase for next year. The professional-allowance increase is estimated to climb sharply—by around 20% for some grades—affecting roughly NT$16 billion in expenditure. The adjustment reflects the government's effort to keep public-sector compensation competitive and support household purchasing power amid rising living costs. As one of the larger public-sector pay revisions in recent years, the measure carries fiscal implications and could influence broader wage-setting expectations, private-sector pay benchmarks and domestic consumption in the coming year.

items.title_zh: 台幣連二貶 探15個月新低 股利匯出壓力持續
items.title_en: New Taiwan dollar falls for a second day to a 15-month low on dividend-remittance pressure
items.summary_zh: 新台幣連續第二個交易日走弱，探15個月新低，主因外資股利匯出賣壓持續壓抑匯價。新台幣前一交易日在量縮下貶值1.7分、收32.189元兌1美元，隔日則開高。分析指出，外資季節性股利匯出壓力是主要拖累，惟出口基本面有望在32.2元附近提供支撐並鋪陳反彈空間。匯價偏軟反映與台灣除息旺季相關的跨境資金流動，以及整體美元走勢，對出口商競爭力、進口原料成本與壽險業外幣資產評價均有影響。對財富管理客戶而言，匯率波動牽動外幣保單、海外債與境外基金的匯兌損益，後續須留意股利匯出旺季結束後，出口收匯能否帶動新台幣止穩回升，並關注央行對匯市的調節態度。
items.summary_en: The New Taiwan dollar weakened for a second consecutive session, sliding to a 15-month low as persistent foreign dividend-remittance outflows weighed on the currency. The NTD closed the prior session down 1.7 cents at NT$32.189 per U.S. dollar amid thin volume, before opening firmer the next day. Analysts note that seasonal dividend-repatriation pressure from foreign investors has been a key drag, though export fundamentals could offer support around the NT$32.2 level and pave the way for a rebound. The currency's softness reflects cross-border capital flows tied to Taiwan's dividend season and broader dollar dynamics, with implications for exporters' competitiveness, imported-input costs and life insurers' foreign-currency asset valuations.

items.title_zh: 明年科技預算先期規劃1,768億元創新高 增百億元
items.title_en: Next year's preliminary tech budget set at record NT$176.8 billion, up NT$10 billion
items.summary_zh: 國科會委員會通過2027年科技預算先期作業1,768億元、創下新高，較今年增加約百億元，是推動台灣從「矽島」進化為「AI之島」的一環。經費將持續投入「AI新十大建設」與五大信賴產業，包括大南方新矽谷方案、晶創台灣方案及次世代等計畫。此創高預算顯示國家對AI、先進半導體與策略性科技的投資延續，旨在強化台灣產業競爭力，並在全球科技競爭加劇下，鞏固高附加價值產業的長期成長動能。對產業與資本市場而言，政府持續加碼科技預算，有助支撐AI與半導體供應鏈的中長期發展題材，惟預算執行成效與民間投資的實際帶動效果，仍須後續觀察，並留意資源配置能否精準對接產業需求。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) committee approved preliminary planning for the 2027 science-and-technology budget at NT$176.8 billion—a record high and about NT$10 billion more than this year—as part of the drive to transform Taiwan from a "silicon island" into an "AI island." The funding will continue to flow into the "AI New Ten Major Construction" projects and five trusted industries, including the Greater Southern Silicon Valley plan, the Chip Taiwan (晶創台灣) initiative and next-generation programmes. The record budget signals sustained state investment in AI, advanced semiconductors and strategic technologies, aiming to reinforce Taiwan's industrial competitiveness and anchor long-term growth in high-value sectors amid intensifying global tech competition.

items.title_zh: 美晶片股賣壓蔓延亞洲 韓股跌逾7% 日經挫2,000點 SK海力士重挫11%
items.title_en: U.S. chip selloff spreads across Asia: Kospi drops over 7%, Nikkei sheds 2,000 points
items.summary_zh: 美國晶片股賣壓蔓延至亞洲市場，拖累半導體權重高的指數重挫。南韓KOSPI跌逾7%、日經指數挫約2,000點，SK海力士在首爾盤中重挫約11%。此波下殺反映市場在AI與記憶體晶片股強漲後，對估值偏高的疑慮升溫，加上對記憶體擴產的憂慮。亞股急跌凸顯亞洲科技市場與華爾街半導體走勢高度連動，晶片與記憶體權值股首當其衝。此同步弱勢也外溢至台灣，台股同樣開低重挫，凸顯半導體族群對區域市場氣氛的巨大影響力。對投資人而言，記憶體與AI概念股的劇烈波動，提醒須留意高估值族群的回檔風險與資金輪動節奏。
items.summary_en: A selloff in U.S. chipmakers spilled into Asian markets, sending semiconductor-heavy indices sharply lower. South Korea's Kospi fell more than 7% and Japan's Nikkei tumbled around 2,000 points, while SK Hynix plunged about 11% in Seoul. The rout reflected mounting caution over stretched AI and memory-chip valuations after a strong run, compounded by worries over expanding memory capacity. The sharp regional pullback underscores how closely Asian tech markets track Wall Street's semiconductor moves, with heavyweight chip and memory names bearing the brunt. The synchronised weakness rippled into Taiwan, where the Taiex also opened sharply lower, highlighting the sector's outsized influence on regional sentiment.

items.title_zh: 中國長鑫存儲IPO擴產引憂慮 美光、SanDisk、SK海力士ADR崩超8%
items.title_en: China's CXMT IPO expansion fears hammer memory stocks; Micron, SK Hynix ADRs slump over 8%
items.summary_zh: 市場擔憂中國長鑫存儲（CXMT）即將啟動首次公開募股（IPO），並藉募資大幅擴充產能，恐加劇全球DRAM市場競爭，記憶體族群週三遭遇沉重賣壓，美光、SanDisk與SK海力士ADR同步下挫逾8%。市場憂慮的核心在於，若長鑫積極擴產恐造成供給過剩，威脅支撐記憶體近期漲勢的價格話語權。此波賣壓凸顯中國供給面的變化，能迅速重新定調全球記憶體供應鏈的市場情緒，也拖累台灣記憶體相關個股，並加深整體晶片族群的修正。對投資人而言，記憶體超級循環行情能否延續，將取決於供需平衡與擴產節奏，後續須密切關注中國廠商產能開出的實際進度與價格走勢。
items.summary_en: Markets grew anxious over Chinese memory maker CXMT (長鑫存儲) launching an IPO and using the proceeds to sharply expand production, raising fears of intensified competition in the global DRAM market. Memory names came under heavy selling pressure on Wednesday, with the ADRs of Micron, SanDisk and SK Hynix all sliding more than 8%. The concern centres on potential oversupply if CXMT ramps capacity aggressively, threatening the pricing power that has underpinned the memory sector's recent rally. The selloff highlights how supply-side developments in China can swiftly reset sentiment across the global memory chain, weighing on Taiwanese memory-related names and adding to the broader chip-sector correction.

items.title_zh: 川普警告伊朗：不談判就炸電廠、橋樑 美再祭新制裁
items.title_en: Trump warns Iran: negotiate or face strikes on power plants and bridges
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普表示，若伊朗拒絕重返談判，美方將攻擊能源設施、發電廠與橋樑。同時，美國再擴大制裁伊朗航運網路，鎖定逾200名個人、實體及船舶；伊朗革命衛隊則宣稱已攻擊美軍在巴林與科威特的據點。此波升級使美伊衝突走向危險方向，軍事集結與海上封鎖升高對能源基礎設施與區域航運的風險。此對峙使油價與地緣政治風險續居全球市場焦點，牽動能源、國防與避險資產的波動，投資人正評估進一步升級的可能。對台灣與亞洲市場而言，中東情勢牽動油價與運價，對進口能源成本與航運、化工等產業帶來連動影響，後續須密切關注荷姆茲海峽航運安全與地緣風險演變。
items.summary_en: U.S. President Donald Trump warned that if Iran refuses to return to negotiations, Washington will attack energy facilities, power plants and bridges. The U.S. also widened sanctions on Iran's shipping network, targeting more than 200 individuals, entities and vessels, while Iran's Revolutionary Guard claimed it had struck U.S. bases in Bahrain and Kuwait. The escalation keeps the U.S.–Iran conflict on a dangerous trajectory, with the military build-up and naval blockade raising risks to energy infrastructure and shipping through the region. The standoff has kept oil prices and geopolitical risk in focus for global markets, feeding volatility across energy, defence and safe-haven assets as investors weigh the potential for further escalation.

items.title_zh: AI熱潮受惠者不只科技股 高盛、摩根大通創歷史新高營收
items.title_en: AI boom lifts Wall Street banks too: Goldman, JPMorgan post record revenue
items.summary_zh: AI投資熱潮持續擴散，不僅帶旺科技股，也讓華爾街大型銀行成為新贏家。高盛與摩根大通受惠於股票交易、IPO及AI基建融資需求大增，雙雙繳出創紀錄營收，高層更直言AI已遍布全球金融市場。此成績凸顯AI資本支出循環正在資本市場各環節創造手續費收入——從大型併購顧問到資料中心與晶片投資融資——使此題材的受惠者遠超出晶片商與雲端業者。對投資人而言，銀行創高獲利顯示AI帶動的需求正重塑金融業各領域的營收來源，而非僅侷限於科技股。此趨勢也提醒，AI浪潮的投資布局可擴及金融、能源等外溢受惠產業，惟仍須留意景氣循環與市場波動對投資銀行業務的影響。
items.summary_en: The AI investment wave is spreading beyond technology stocks, turning Wall Street's largest banks into new winners. Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan both posted record revenue, benefiting from a surge in equities trading, IPO activity and financing demand tied to AI infrastructure buildout. Executives went so far as to say AI now permeates global financial markets. The results underscore how the AI capex cycle is generating fee income across capital markets—from advising on mega-deals to funding data-centre and chip investments—broadening the theme's beneficiaries well beyond chipmakers and cloud providers. For investors, the record bank earnings signal that AI-driven demand is reshaping revenue streams across the financial sector, not just the technology complex.

items.title_zh: SK海力士暴跌10% 亞洲科技股跟隨美股晶片賣壓重挫（2026-07-16）
items.title_en: SK Hynix shares plunge 10% as Asia sees tech rout tracking U.S. chip losses (2026-07-16)
items.summary_zh: 亞洲半導體股週四重挫，美國晶片股賣壓蔓延至區域市場，SK海力士盤中暴跌約10%。此波下殺拖累亞洲各市場的記憶體與AI相關個股，反映區域科技股與華爾街半導體走勢高度連動，市場對晶片族群估值的疑慮升溫。
items.summary_en: Asian semiconductor stocks tumbled on Thursday as a selloff in U.S. chipmakers spilled into the region, with SK Hynix plunging about 10%. The rout weighed on memory and AI-linked names across Asian markets, reflecting how closely regional tech shares track Wall Street's semiconductor moves.

items.title_zh: 美國6月批發物價意外下滑0.3% 汽油大跌是主因（2026-07-15）
items.title_en: Wholesale prices unexpectedly declined 0.3% in June on big drop in gasoline (2026-07-15)
items.summary_zh: 美國6月批發物價（PPI）意外下滑0.3%，主因能源成本回落、汽油價格大跌，油價在美伊緊張短暫緩和期間走低。此偏弱的生產者物價數據，與趨緩的消費者通膨相呼應，強化上月物價壓力減輕的訊號，也牽動市場對聯準會後續貨幣政策路徑的預期。
items.summary_en: U.S. wholesale prices unexpectedly fell 0.3% in June, aided by easing energy costs and a sharp drop in gasoline, as oil prices declined during a brief pause in U.S.–Iran tensions. The softer producer-price reading echoed cooler consumer inflation, reinforcing signs that price pressures eased last month.

items.title_zh: 美國6月CPI年增3.5% 低於預期、能源價格回落（2026-07-15）
items.title_en: Consumer prices rose 3.5% annually in June, less than expected as energy prices eased (2026-07-15)
items.summary_zh: 美國6月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增3.5%，低於市場預期的3.8%，能源成本回落有助壓抑整體通膨數據。此低於預期的CPI進一步佐證物價壓力趨緩，並重塑市場對聯準會下一步政策動向的預期，帶動市場降低短線升息疑慮。
items.summary_en: U.S. consumer prices climbed 3.5% year-on-year in June, below the 3.8% expected, as easing energy costs helped tame the headline inflation reading. The cooler-than-forecast CPI added to evidence of moderating price pressures and reshaped market expectations for the Federal Reserve's next policy moves.

items.title_zh: 南韓央行升息至2.75% 逾三年來首度升息（2026-07-16）
items.title_en: Bank of Korea raises rates to 2.75% in first hike in over three years (2026-07-16)
items.summary_zh: 南韓央行升息1碼至2.75%，為逾三年來首度升息，與路透調查的經濟學家預期一致。此舉顯示南韓央行在自身通膨與金融穩定考量下轉向緊縮，對韓元與韓股走勢均有影響，也為亞洲貨幣政策動向增添觀察指標，市場關注後續升息路徑與對半導體重權股的衝擊。
items.summary_en: The Bank of Korea raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 2.75%, its first hike in more than three years and in line with a Reuters poll of economists. The move signals the central bank's shift toward tightening amid its own inflation and financial-stability considerations, with implications for the won and Korean equities.

items.title_zh: 中國第二季GDP創2022年來最慢增速 投資疲弱（2026-07-15）
items.title_en: China posts slowest quarterly growth since 2022 as investment slumps (2026-07-15)
items.summary_zh: 中國第二季GDP增速創2022年以來最慢，投資大幅走弱，低於北京設定的4.5%至5%全年成長目標區間——這是數十年來最不進取的目標。疲弱數據引發市場對加碼刺激措施以支撐這個全球第二大經濟體的呼聲，內需低迷成為關注焦點，也牽動全球對中國經濟前景與相關供應鏈需求的評估。
items.summary_en: China's second-quarter GDP growth came in at its slowest since 2022 as investment slumped, falling below Beijing's full-year target range of 4.5% to 5%—the least ambitious goal in decades. The weak reading fanned calls for additional stimulus to shore up the world's second-largest economy amid soft domestic demand.

items.title_zh: Anthropic逼近大型IPO 銀行安排投資人會議（2026-07-16）
items.title_en: Anthropic moves closer to mega-IPO as bankers line up investor meetings (2026-07-16)
items.summary_zh: AI新創Anthropic正安排投資人會議，籌備最快10月的潛在IPO，力圖搶在對手OpenAI之前登陸公開市場。此舉顯示領先AI公司爭取公開市場資金的競爭加劇，若順利推進，將成為市場最受矚目的科技掛牌案之一，也反映AI產業在資本市場的高度熱度與募資動能。
items.summary_en: Anthropic is lining up investor meetings ahead of a potential IPO as soon as October, as the AI startup looks to beat rival OpenAI to the public markets. The move signals intensifying competition among leading AI firms to tap public capital, and would mark one of the most closely watched technology listings if it proceeds.

items.title_zh: 貝萊德資產突破15兆美元 股價大漲近7%（2026-07-16）
items.title_en: BlackRock shares rally after assets soar past $15 trillion (2026-07-16)
items.summary_zh: 貝萊德（BlackRock）公布獲利較去年同期成長20%，管理資產規模（AUM）突破15兆美元，帶動股價大漲近7%。此成績凸顯這家資產管理巨頭持續成長與強勁的投資人資金流入，鞏固其在全球資本市場的核心地位，也反映被動投資與ETF需求延續為資產管理業帶來的規模效應。
items.summary_en: BlackRock reported that profits rose 20% from a year earlier and its assets under management soared past $15 trillion, sending shares rallying almost 7%. The results underscore the asset-management giant's continued growth and strong investor inflows, reinforcing its position at the centre of global capital markets.

items.title_zh: Stripe聯手私募基金Advent擬收購PayPal（2026-07-15）
items.title_en: Stripe and private-equity firm Advent offer to buy PayPal (2026-07-15)
items.summary_zh: 支付新創Stripe與私募股權集團Advent International聯手提出收購PayPal，交易估值約530億美元。消息傳出後，PayPal股價盤前勁揚。此案若成局，將躋身最大宗金融科技併購之一，並重塑數位支付的競爭版圖，市場關注監管審查與後續整合進展，也凸顯支付產業併購整併的加速趨勢。
items.summary_en: Payments startup Stripe and private-equity group Advent International have jointly offered to buy PayPal in a deal that would value the fintech company at around $53 billion. PayPal shares surged in premarket trade on reports of the takeover, which would rank among the largest fintech buyouts and reshape the competitive landscape in digital payments.

items.title_zh: SpaceX股價首度跌破IPO發行價（2026-07-16）
items.title_en: SpaceX shares fall below IPO price for the first time (2026-07-16)
items.summary_zh: SpaceX股價首度跌破135美元的IPO發行價，因科技股權重高的那斯達克指數走跌。這家火箭製造商股價盤中一度創歷史新低，終場收在接近發行價水準，反映市場回檔之際，高知名度科技股普遍承壓，投資人對估值偏高的疑慮升溫，也顯示新掛牌熱門股在大盤修正時的波動風險。
items.summary_en: SpaceX shares slipped below their $135 IPO price for the first time as the tech-heavy Nasdaq composite dropped. The rocket maker's stock touched an intraday record low before closing near the offering level, reflecting broader pressure on high-profile tech names amid a market pullback and caution over stretched valuations.

items.title_zh: AI規模太大 投資人已無可迴避（2026-07-16）
items.title_en: AI is so big, it's now impossible for investors to avoid (2026-07-16)
items.summary_zh: MarketWatch指出，AI熱潮的曝險已幾乎讓投資人無可迴避。此題材不僅主導股市，更系統性地滲透企業信用債與創投市場，意味即便是分散配置的投資組合，如今也在多種資產類別中承載沉重且往往難以避開的AI曝險。此現象提醒投資人重新檢視風險集中度，留意AI題材若出現大幅修正時對整體資產配置的連動衝擊。
items.summary_en: Exposure to the artificial-intelligence boom has become virtually impossible for investors to avoid, according to MarketWatch. The theme has not only cornered the stock market but has systematically swallowed up corporate credit and venture capital, meaning even diversified portfolios now carry heavy, often unavoidable, AI exposure across multiple asset classes.
